title: Kin
text: Word of the favour got round. {who} is the third to ask for their own line to be thawed next.

choices.label: No more favours
choices.reply: The rule stands again: rarest line first. A few people think it should never have bent.

choices.label: Draw lots
choices.reply: Each pod, one family line by lot from the ones running short. It feels fair, mostly.
